February 2, 2026

# Northwind releases 2025 annual report

PORTSMITH—Northwind Community Credit Union released its annual report today.

- 310 Northwind employees used Volunteer Day in 2025 to serve local nonprofits.

Northwind Community Credit Union is a member-owned financial cooperative. It has 14 branch office locations and 320 employees.
